[[File:JW Millet 2007 World Championship interview.jpg|thumb|right|260px|JW Millet at the 2007 World Championship]]
'''JW Millet''' (forum handle '''Asphalizo''') played the [[2007 World Championship]] and the [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2013/2013TMWDay1.pdf 2013 Texas Mini Worlds], starwarsccg.org</ref>

His name is sometimes spelled ''J.W. Miller'' (2007 Worlds published decklists; the handwritten sheet reads J.W. Millet)<ref name="pc2007">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2007-decklists/ 2007 Decklists], starwarsccg.org</ref> or ''JD Millet'' (title of a 2007 Worlds interview video).<ref name="yt">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jO2dTROIHs Worlds 2007 Interview JD Millet], Star Wars CCG (YouTube). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012182432/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6jO2dTROIHs Internet Archive]</ref> He earned a Day 2 bye for the [[2009 World Championship]] from the main event of the [[2009 Texas Mini Worlds]].<ref name="t29274">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=437122#p437122 2009 Worlds Day 2 Byes], imrahil327, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (31 July 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012183536/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t29274.html Internet Archive]</ref>
